title: Occasion Rush Discount Linked to a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
A customer whose Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry event falls on the date a garment is needed receives an occasion rush discount on Marlowe & Finch Alterations rush work. The registry must be active and its event date must be the ticket's needed-by date.

| The customer's active registries whose event date is the ticket's needed-by date | Occasion rush discount |
|---|---|
| At least one such registry, and it is a Wedding Registry | 10 percent |
| Such registries exist, and none is a Wedding Registry | 5 percent |
| No such registry | none |
| The ticket records no needed-by date | none |

**Records read.** The customer's Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry registries — the registry type (Celebration, Graduation, Housewarming, Baby, Anniversary or Wedding Registry), its status and its event date — compared with the needed-by date on the ticket.

## Matching, both sides (hypothetical dates)

| Registries held | Needed-by date on the ticket | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Wedding Registry, active, event on 14 June | 14 June | 10 percent |
| Wedding Registry, active, event on 15 June | 14 June | none (event date is not the needed-by date) |
| Anniversary Registry, active, event on 14 June; Wedding Registry, active, event on 20 September | 14 June | 5 percent |
| Wedding Registry, closed, event on 14 June | 14 June | none (not active) |
| Baby Registry, active, event on 14 June | no needed-by date | none |
